        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    colors=set(cnt)-{0}
    rects=[]
    for c in sorted(colors,key=lambda x:cnt[x]):
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        perim=2*(rs[-1]-rs[0]+1)+2*(cs[-1]-cs[0]+1)-4
        if len(pts)==perim and all(p[0] in (rs[0],rs[-1]) or p[1] in (cs[0],cs[-1]) for p in pts):
            rects.append((c,rs[0],cs[0],rs[-1],cs[-1]))
    noise=sorted({c for c,*a,b,_,_ in rects}) 
    # choose frames by size rank -> but noise colors must not include frame colors. Use the non-frame colors: those whose count differs from any perfect bbox
    framecols={r[0] for r in rects}
    noise=sorted(colors-framecols,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    return noise  # placeholder
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

from collections import Counter
def rect(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    rects=[]
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if c==0: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        perim=2*(rs[-1]-rs[0]+1)+2*(cs[-1]-cs[0]+1)-4
        ok=n==perim and all(p[0] in (rs[0],rs[-1]) or p[1] in (cs[0],cs[-1]) for p in pts)
        if ok:
            hgt,wid=rs[-1]-rs[0],cs[-1]-cs[0]
            area=(hgt-1)*(wid-1)
            pts_in=[p for p in pts if (p[0]>rs[0] and p[0]<rs[-1] and p[1]>cs[0] and p[1]<cs[-1])]
            rects.append({'c':c,'pts':pts,'in_border':len(pts)-len(pts_in),'bbox':(rs[0],cs[0],rs[-1],cs[-1]),'area':area,'n':n})

from collections import Counter

def comps_of(g, bg=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    if bg is None: bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                v=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen[r][c]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=a+dy,b+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==v:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cc=[p[1] for p in comp]
                rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
                onborder=all(r==rmin or r==rmax or c==cmin or c==cmax for r,c in comp)
                interior=(rmax-rmin-1)*(cmax-cmin-1)>0
                res.append({'color':v,'size':len(comp),'bbox':(rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax),
                            'closed':onborder,'has_interior':interior})
    return res,bg

def f(g):
    cs,bg=comps_of(g)
    frames=[o for o in cs if o['closed'] and o['has_interior']]
    strays=[o for o in cs if not o['closed']]
    # frame interiors sorted small->big, stray colors sorted by count asc
    frames.sort(key=lambda o:(o['bbox'][0],o['bbox'][1]))
    sc=Counter(o['color'] for o in strays)
    colors=sorted(sc,key=sc.get)
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    for fi,f in enumerate(frames):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=f['bbox']
        col=colors[fi]
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                rr=r-r0; cc2=c-c0
                if (rr-cc2)%2==0:
                    out[r][c]=col
    return out

for n in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, f(gi)==go)
import json
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                v=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen[r][c]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=a+dy,b+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==v:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; ccs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(ccs),max(ccs)
                res.append({'color':v,'bbox':(rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax),'size':len(comp)})
    frs=sorted([o for o in res if o['size']>=8],key=lambda o:o['bbox'][0])
    strs=[o for o in res if o['size']==1]
    ncols=sorted(set(s['color'] for s in strs))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,f in enumerate(frs):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=f['bbox']
        fill=ncols[(i+1)%len(ncols)]
        inner=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1)]
        par=sum(rr-r0+cc-c0%2 for rr,cc in inner)  # placeholder
        counts=Counter((rr+cc)%2 for rr,cc in inner)
        bestpar=max(counts,key=counts.get)
        for rr,cc in inner:
            if (rr+cc)%2==bestpar: out[rr][cc]=fill
    return out

for n in (1,2,3):

                rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; ccs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                res.append({'color':v,'bbox':(min(rs),max(rs),min(ccs),max(ccs)),'size':len(comp),'cells':set(comp)})
    return res,bg

def f2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs,bg=comps(g)
    frs=sorted([o for o in cs if o['size']>=8],key=lambda o:o['bbox'][0])
    strs=[o for o in cs if o['size']==1]
    # noise colors sorted by frequency ascending (rarer first) - but check counts
    cntc=defaultdict(int)
    for s in strs: cntc[s['color']]+=1
    ncols=sorted(set(cntc), key=cntc.get)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,f in enumerate(frs):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=f['bbox']
        fill=ncols[(i+1)%len(ncols)]
        inner=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1)]
        pc=Counter((rr+cc)%2 for rr,cc in inner)
        bp=pc.most_common(1)[0][0]
        for rr,cc in inner:
            if (rr+cc)%2==bp: out[rr][cc]=fill
        for r,c in set().union(*[s['cells'] for s in strs]): out[r][c]=bg
    return out

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def find_frames(g):
    cs,bg=comps(g)
    frs=[]
    for o in cs:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=o['bbox']
        per=all(g[r][c]==o['color'] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1))
        if per and o['size']>=4: frs.append(o)
    return frs,bg
for n in (1,2,3):
